dedupe_keys.name: public sector deficits and macroeconomic performance dataset

description: Public Sector Deficits and Macroeconomic Performance Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This data set presents annual data on public sector deficits, the monetary sector, and the financial sector for a large and varying sample of member countries of the OECD and developing countries. It includes an in-depth examination of eight countries - Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Morocco, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe. Coverage: the whole world. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
